# JEE Prep — PDF to CBT Converter

JEE Prep includes a browser-based PDF to computer-based-test workspace.

## Features
- Convert question-paper PDFs into an interactive exam experience.
- Timer, question palette, marks and exam navigation.
- Local/browser-based question workflow supplied by the integrated converter package.

## App
- https://jeeprep.in/cbtconverter

The main JEE Prep Hub application owns the site header, navigation and global theme.
